title: Classic cheese omelette
summary: Three eggs, a handful of cheese, two minutes in the pan. The fastest way to use up eggs.
steps: Whisk the eggs with a splash of milk, salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat until foaming.
Pour in the eggs and drag the edges to the middle as they set.
Scatter cheese over one half, fold, and slide onto a plate.

title: Spinach & cheese scrambled eggs
summary: Wilting spinach disappears into soft scrambled eggs.
steps: Wilt the spinach in butter for a minute, then squeeze out the water.
Add the beaten eggs and stir gently over low heat until just set.
Stir through the cheese and serve on toast.

title: Creamy mushroom pasta
summary: Garlicky mushrooms in a silky sauce. Cream is best, but milk and a little cheese works too.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water; keep a mug of the cooking water.
Fry sliced mushrooms hard in butter and oil until golden, then add the garlic.
Add the cream (or a splash of pasta water and cheese) and simmer for a minute.
Toss the pasta through the sauce, loosening with pasta water.

title: Chicken & pepper stir-fry
summary: A fast wok dinner that eats through whatever vegetables are going soft.
steps: Get the rice on first.
Stir-fry the chicken in very hot oil until browned, then set aside.
Fry the onion, pepper and carrot for 3 minutes, add the garlic.
Return the chicken, splash in soy sauce and toss for a minute. Serve on rice.

title: Blistered tomato pasta
summary: Soft cherry tomatoes collapse into a sauce with garlic and olive oil.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Fry the tomatoes in plenty of olive oil until they burst, then add sliced garlic.
Crush a few tomatoes with a spoon, season, and toss with the pasta and a little cooking water.
Finish with cheese and basil.

title: Cheese toastie
summary: Bread going stale and a wedge of cheese: the classic rescue.
steps: Butter the outside of both slices.
Fill with cheese (and onion) and toast in a dry pan over medium heat, pressing down.
Flip when golden and cook until the cheese melts.

title: French toast
summary: Stale bread is actually better here. Eggs and milk soak in, then it's fried golden.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and sugar in a shallow dish.
Soak each slice for 20 seconds a side.
Fry in butter until golden on both sides. Top with banana.

title: Banana pancakes
summary: Overripe bananas mashed into a quick batter.
steps: Mash the bananas, whisk in the eggs and milk, then fold in the flour.
Fry small ladlefuls in butter for 2 minutes a side.
Serve with anything sweet you have.

title: Leftover veg frittata
summary: An oven omelette that takes any cooked or soft vegetables.
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in oil in an ovenproof pan, then add the potato.
Pour over the beaten, seasoned eggs and scatter with cheese.
Cook on the hob for 5 minutes, then finish under the grill until set and golden.

title: Chicken & rice soup
summary: A big comforting pot that stretches a little chicken a long way.
steps: Sweat the onion, carrot and garlic in a little oil for 8 minutes.
Add the stock and chicken; simmer 15 minutes, then lift out and shred the chicken.
Add the rice and cook until tender, return the chicken and season with lemon.

title: Lemon garlic salmon
summary: Salmon fillets in a butter, garlic and lemon pan sauce with wilted spinach.
steps: Season the salmon and fry skin-side down in a little oil for 4 minutes.
Flip, add the butter and garlic, and baste for 2 minutes.
Squeeze in the lemon, add the spinach to wilt, and serve.

title: Spaghetti carbonara
summary: Bacon, eggs and cheese make the sauce. No cream needed.
steps: Cook the spaghetti; keep a mug of cooking water.
Fry the chopped bacon until crisp and turn off the heat.
Whisk the eggs with the cheese and pepper.
Toss the hot pasta in the bacon pan, then off the heat stir in the egg mix, loosening with pasta water until glossy.

title: Mushroom risotto
summary: Slow-stirred rice with browned mushrooms and plenty of cheese.
steps: Fry the mushrooms in half the butter until golden; set aside.
Soften the onion in the rest of the butter, add the rice and stir for a minute.
Add stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until the rice is creamy and just tender.
Stir in the mushrooms and cheese, season, and rest for 2 minutes.

title: Bacon & egg breakfast roll
summary: Crisp bacon, a fried egg, whatever bread you've got.
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp, then fry the egg in the bacon fat.
Toast the bread, butter it, and stack.

title: Roasted tomato soup
summary: Soft tomatoes roasted with onion and garlic, then blended.
steps: Roast the tomatoes, onion and garlic with the oil at 200°C for 30 minutes.
Blend with the stock until smooth, season, and add cream if you like.
Serve with toasted bread.

title: Garlic butter potatoes
summary: Crushed boiled potatoes crisped in garlic butter.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and lightly crush.
Fry in butter with the garlic until the edges are crisp. Season and add parsley.

title: Fridge-raid fried rice
summary: Leftover rice, an egg, and any vegetables that need using. Cold rice fries best.
steps: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set aside.
Fry the onion, carrot and pepper for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and chicken, fry until sizzling, then splash in soy sauce and stir in the egg.

title: Yogurt & banana parfait
summary: Layers of yogurt, fruit and crunch for breakfast or dessert.
steps: Layer yogurt with sliced banana, berries and oats in a glass.
Drizzle with honey.

title: Chicken Caesar wrap
summary: Leftover chicken, crunchy lettuce and a quick yogurt dressing.
steps: Mix the yogurt with cheese, lemon, salt and pepper.
Pile chicken and lettuce into the tortilla, spoon over the dressing, and roll.

title: Cheesy stuffed peppers
summary: Peppers filled with tomato rice and baked under cheese.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic, stir in the tomatoes and rice, and season.
Fill the pepper halves, top with cheese and bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.

title: Spinach & mushroom quesadilla
summary: A crisp folded tortilla with melted cheese and wilted greens.
steps: Fry the mushrooms, add the spinach to wilt, and season.
Spread over half the tortilla with the cheese, fold, and toast in the pan until golden both sides.

title: Weeknight bolognese
summary: A quick meat sauce that's better the next day and freezes well.
steps: Brown the mince hard, then add the onion, carrot and garlic.
Add the tomatoes and a splash of water; simmer 25 minutes.
Serve over pasta with cheese.

title: Carrot & ginger soup
summary: Sweet, warming and uses a whole bag of carrots.
steps: Sweat the onion, garlic and ginger, add the chopped carrots and stock.
Simmer 20 minutes, blend smooth, and season. Add cream if you like.

title: Bread & butter pudding
summary: The definitive use for a stale loaf.
steps: Butter the bread, cut into triangles and layer in a dish with raisins.
Whisk the eggs, milk and sugar; pour over and leave 15 minutes.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until puffed and golden.

title: Salmon fried rice
summary: Flaked salmon through egg fried rice.
steps: Pan-fry the salmon, then flake it.
Scramble the eggs in a hot wok, add the rice and carrot, fry hard.
Fold in the salmon, soy sauce and spring onion.

title: Roast vegetable traybake
summary: Everything that's going soft, roasted until sweet and crisp.
steps: Toss everything in oil and salt on a large tray.
Roast at 200°C for 35–40 minutes, turning once, until caramelised.

title: Lemon chicken traybake
summary: One tray: chicken, potatoes, lemon and garlic.
steps: Toss everything with oil and salt in a roasting tin, chicken on top.
Roast at 200°C for 40–45 minutes until the chicken is golden and potatoes are crisp.

title: Egg fried noodles
summary: Ten-minute noodles with egg and crunchy veg.
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the carrot and garlic, push aside, scramble the egg.
Toss in the noodles and soy sauce.

title: Cheesy baked potatoes
summary: Crisp skins, fluffy middles, molten cheese.
steps: Bake the potatoes at 200°C for an hour until the skins are crisp.
Split, mash the insides with butter and most of the cheese, refill and top with the rest.
Return to the oven for 10 minutes. Scatter with bacon.

title: Overnight oats
summary: Stir it together tonight, breakfast is done.
steps: Mix the oats, milk and yogurt in a jar and refrigerate overnight.
Top with banana and honey in the morning.

title: Banana smoothie
summary: Speckled bananas are the sweetest — blend them.
steps: Blend everything until smooth. Add ice if you like it cold.

title: Tuna pasta bake
summary: Store-cupboard tuna with cheese and tomatoes, baked golden.
steps: Cook the pasta; soften the onion and add the tomatoes to make a sauce.
Stir in the tuna, pasta, cream and half the cheese.
Top with the remaining cheese and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

title: Shakshuka
summary: Eggs poached in a spiced pepper and tomato sauce.
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in oil, add the garlic, then the tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites set.
Scatter with cheese and serve with bread.

title: Crunchy veg stir-fry
summary: Peppers, carrots and mushrooms with garlic and soy, over rice or noodles.
steps: Slice all the vegetables thinly.
Stir-fry in very hot oil for 4 minutes, add the garlic and soy sauce, toss and serve.

title: Creamy chicken & mushrooms
summary: Pan-fried chicken in a garlicky mushroom cream sauce.
steps: Brown the chicken in butter, then set aside.
Fry the mushrooms and onion until golden, add the garlic, then the cream.
Return the chicken and simmer 8 minutes until cooked through.
